description: SimpleCom is a Minecraft voice communication mod that enables in-game push-to-talk voice chat

mods.description: 简单的通讯器客户端

mods.name: SimpleCom
mods.description: SimpleCom (简单的通讯器) - Push-to-talk voice chat using Minecraft payload channels. Solves UDP NAT issues by piggybacking on the existing game connection. Hold V to record, C to switch channels.
